purpose: Numerically qualify the single BC2-C1 case whose preregistered primary internal step exits the strict constitutive domain, without changing any physical state, closure, forcing, geometry, width, history, decomposition identity, or classification rule.

trigger_evidence.original_C1_disposition: C1 original hard gate remains failed; C1R does not retroactively change it.

unchanged_model.q90: same source-aligned standard closure as C0/C1
unchanged_model.H_input: same prescribed qualified BC2-A2 Reference H(t)

numerical_recovery.reason: This is the already preregistered and already qualified C1 cross route, not a newly selected response-fit timestep.
numerical_recovery.qualification_rule: Both recovery routes must complete inside the strict constitutive domain and satisfy all inherited C1 additive and moving-ledger hard gates.
numerical_recovery.convergence_rule: Per-channel dominance classification at 0.00005 and 0.000025 must be identical. Quantitative RMS differences are reported without a post-hoc threshold.
forbidden: no omission of WT_CYCLE response segments

use_in_final_C1_adjudication: If C1R passes, the blocked 2.5-cm WT_CYCLE channel classifications may be supplied by C1R while the original C1 primary-route failure remains explicitly reported. This is numerical qualification recovery, not a claim that original C1 passed unchanged.
